body: You are now both in the calendar invite.

As discussed, some folks from the i18n WG will join us this meeting and mainly drive the agenda.

It looks like @aphillips prepared https://github.com/w3c/i18n-activity/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3AAgenda%2BI18N%2BWHATWG. Not sure we'll be able to get through all of them, but let's do our best.

Thank you all for attending today! Here are the notes from this meeting (the next one is at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10156):

### Agenda  
Attendees: Luke Warlow, Joey Arhar, Panos Astithas, Emilio Cobos Álvarez, Brecht De Ruyte, Mason Freed, Chris Harrelson, Richard Ishida, Sanket Joshi, Una Kravets, Oliver Medhurst, Olli Pettay, Addison Phillips, Noam Rosenthal, Kagami Rosylight, Atsushi Shimono, Henri Sivonen, Anne van Kesteren, Greg Whitworth, Chris Wilson, Stephanie Zhang, Keith Cirkel, Vladimir Levin, Khushal Sagar

1. Review past action items
    1. Dan will follow up internally to find someone to present [A way to disable animation of cancelled drag for editor apps like VS Code](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10039) at a future meeting.
        1. Trying to get an explainer in place, will add it back when ready.
    1. Marcos will follow up with heycam on WebKit's opinion on [Add a layer and filter interface in the 2D canvas](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9537).
        1. Deferring again. Anne will ping heycam.
    1. Joey to get data on how many pages would break if we removed the parser special case for the [Stylable `<select>` element](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9799).
        1. Use counters added ([[1]](https://chromestatus.com/metrics/feature/popularity#HTMLDatalistInSelect), [[2]](https://chromestatus.com/metrics/feature/popularity#HTMLButtonInSelect), [[3]](https://chromestatus.com/metrics/feature/popularity#SelectParserDroppedTag)).
        1. Is this ready for the stage-entering discussion next time? Very likely to be ready this week. The Steering Group will label this issue with `stage: 1` after they publish the stages process.
1. Carryovers from last time
    1. Joint session with the I18N WG ([tagged issues](https://github.com/w3c/i18n-activity/labels/Agenda%2BI18N%2BWHATWG)). Top priorities:
        1. [Add `&nnbsp;` entity for `U+202F`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/5121)
            1. Richard provided a [list](https://github.com/w3c/i18n-actions/issues/73#issuecomment-1954028449) of the desired invisible characters. The discussion will continue on the issue.
        1. [Validating internationalized mail addresses in `<input type="email">`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/4562) ([PR](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/5799))
            1. Henri suggested that this should be opt-in. Luke suggested backend validation. Anne agreed, but gave up pursuing this due to the broad set of required use cases that were presented in the issue. Addison will update the PR with the provided feedback.
        1. [Discuss i18n-glossary and Infra harmonization](https://github.com/w3c/i18n-activity/issues/1815)
            1. We should try to avoid duplication. The discussion will continue offline.
        1. If there is more time:
            1. Time-related issues ([#9542](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9542), [#5488](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/5488))
                1. We didn't have time for this.
            1. Bidi-related issues
                1. We didn't have time for this.
1. New topics
    1. [Mason] [popover=hint](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9776)
        1. The OpenUI folks presented arguments for using a behavior name rather than a UI element name. The discussion will continue on the issue.
    1. [Dominic] [Atomic move operation for element reparenting & reordering](https://github.com/whatwg/dom/issues/1255)
        1. Carryover.
    1. [Emilio] [Render-blocking: the definition of "created by its node document's parser" is a little bit vague](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10145)
        1. Carryover.
    1. [Sanket] [New attribute to control UA-provided writing assistance](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9065)
        1. Carryover.
    1. [Panos] Changing the meeting cadence to weekly.
        1. No objections, since we keep running out of time. Olli agreed, Anne noted that missing some meetings may be more frequent.

### Action Items

1. @marcoscaceres or @annevk will follow up with heycam on WebKit's opinion on [Add a layer and filter interface in the 2D canvas](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9537).
1. The Steering Group will add the `stage: 1 `label to the [Stylable `<select>` element](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9799) issue after they publish the stages process.
1. @aphillips will update the [add support for internationalized email addresses](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/5799) PR with the provided feedback.
1. @past will file an issue with the meeting cadence change for broader visibility.
